translation: The Reality
What is the Reality
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is
(The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come
As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning

arabic: وَأَمّا عادٌ فَأُهلِكوا بِريحٍ صَرصَرٍ عاتِيَةٍ
transliteration: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin
translation: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind

arabic: سَخَّرَها عَلَيهِم سَبعَ لَيالٍ وَثَمٰنِيَةَ أَيّامٍ حُسومًا فَتَرَى القَومَ فيها صَرعىٰ كَأَنَّهُم أَعجازُ نَخلٍ خاوِيَةٍ
transliteration: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun
translation: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees
Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them

arabic: وَجاءَ فِرعَونُ وَمَن قَبلَهُ وَالمُؤتَفِكٰتُ بِالخاطِئَةِ
transliteration: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati
translation: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error

arabic: فَعَصَوا رَسولَ رَبِّهِم فَأَخَذَهُم أَخذَةً رابِيَةً
transliteration: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan
translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip

arabic: إِنّا لَمّا طَغَا الماءُ حَمَلنٰكُم فِى الجارِيَةِ
transliteration: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati
translation: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

arabic: لِنَجعَلَها لَكُم تَذكِرَةً وَتَعِيَها أُذُنٌ وٰعِيَةٌ
transliteration: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun
translation: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember

arabic: فَإِذا نُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ نَفخَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ
transliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun
translation: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ الأَرضُ وَالجِبالُ فَدُكَّتا دَكَّةً وٰحِدَةً
transliteration: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan
translation: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash
Then, on that day will the Event befall
And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail

arabic: وَالمَلَكُ عَلىٰ أَرجائِها وَيَحمِلُ عَرشَ رَبِّكَ فَوقَهُم يَومَئِذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌ
transliteration: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun
translation: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them

arabic: يَومَئِذٍ تُعرَضونَ لا تَخفىٰ مِنكُم خافِيَةٌ
transliteration: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun
translation: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden

arabic: فَأَمّا مَن أوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِيَمينِهِ فَيَقولُ هاؤُمُ اقرَءوا كِتٰبِيَه
transliteration: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah
translation: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book
Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning
Then he will be in blissful state
In a high garden
Whereof the clusters are in easy reach

arabic: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما أَسلَفتُم فِى الأَيّامِ الخالِيَةِ
transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati
translation: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days

arabic: وَأَمّا مَن أوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِشِمالِهِ فَيَقولُ يٰلَيتَنى لَم أوتَ كِتٰبِيَه
transliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah
translation: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
And knew not what my reckoning
Oh, would that it had been death
My wealth hath not availed me
My power hath gone from me
(It will be said): Take him and fetter him
And then expose him to hell-fire

arabic: ثُمَّ فى سِلسِلَةٍ ذَرعُها سَبعونَ ذِراعًا فَاسلُكوهُ
transliteration: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu
translation: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits

arabic: إِنَّهُ كانَ لا يُؤمِنُ بِاللَّهِ العَظيمِ
transliteration: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi
translation: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous
And urged not on the feeding of the wretched
Therefor hath he no lover here this day
Nor any food save filth
Which none but sinners eat
But nay! I swear by all that ye see
And all that ye see not
That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger

arabic: وَما هُوَ بِقَولِ شاعِرٍ قَليلًا ما تُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona
translation: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe

arabic: وَلا بِقَولِ كاهِنٍ قَليلًا ما تَذَكَّرونَ
transliteration: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona
translation: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember
It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us
We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
And then severed his life-artery

arabic: فَما مِنكُم مِن أَحَدٍ عَنهُ حٰجِزينَ
transliteration: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena
translation: And not one of you could have held Us off from him
And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil)
And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)
And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers
And lo! it is absolute truth
So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord
